Because `String.includes()` never returns nullish, `??` short-circuits after the first operand — the search effectively matched **only item name**, and rows with no `inventory_item` were dropped entirely. New: shared `MyVanPage` (`src/components/shared/inventory-routes/my-van-page.tsx:305-317`) uses `[name, type, manufacturer].some(field => …)` and keeps items with no `inventory_item` (`if (!item.inventory_item) return true;`). Users on root "My Van Inventory" will now get type/manufacturer matches they didn't before. This is a deliberate normalization to the lighting/roofing semantics (their old code already used `.some()`), i.e., a fix, but it is a user-visible search-result change. 2. **LOW — `src/routes/_auth/windows/projects.$windowsProjectId.tsx` (project-number prefix changed).** Old: `MAG-LIT-{String(project.project_number).padStart(4, "0")}` — a copy-paste of the lighting page, displaying the wrong division prefix on windows projects.
